title: Returning a part to inventory (restocking) is controlled by Vendor and order management
custom_preconds:
1. A user has a role with Parts Department ON.
  2. Test with Vendor and order management at View only, then at Create & Edit.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as the Create & Edit user and open a part return eligible for return to inventory.
  2. Find the Return to Inventory action, click it and confirm.
  3. Check the quantity is added back to stock.
  4. Log in as the View-only user and open the same kind of part return.
  5. Look for the Return to Inventory action.
custom_expected:
With Vendor and order management Create & Edit, the Return to Inventory action works and stock goes up.

With Vendor and order management View only, the return is not possible.
viu_status: Blocked-UI: restocking (return part to inventory) control not reached — needs a WO/PO with a picked part to exercise the return-to-inventory action gated by Vendor and order management.
